fields.title: If column name casing differs
fields.description:
Controls what counts as a column name match between the input table and the reference table. If
'Rename' is chosen, it still tries to treat the column name as a distinct value (find an exactly
case-sensitive matching column name) first, and then falls back to renaming the column
(case-insensitive matching).

fields.title: If a column is missing in the table
fields.description:
Ensures that the reference columns exist in the input table.
If case insensitive name matching is selected, the first matching column will satisfy this condition.

choices.value: Insert column filled with missing values
choices.label: Insert column filled with missing values

fields.title: If there is an additional column in the table
fields.description:
Specifies how to handle columns which are not included in the reference table but in the table to validate.
Additional columns can cause the validation to fail, be removed, or moved to the end of the table.

fields.title: If data type does not match

choices.value: Try to convert (reject if not compatible)
choices.label: Try to convert (reject if not compatible)

fields.title: If there are missing values
fields.description: Validation fails if any of the columns contains missing values.

fields.title: If categoric value is not in the domain
fields.description:
Allows one to optionally validate categoric values in columns against a set of allowed values.
This option is only enabled if the reference column defines possible values.

fields.title: If numeric value is outside the domain
fields.description:
Checks if each data object is between min and max defined by the domain of the reference column.
This option is only enabled if the reference column defines a numeric domain (min/max).

fields.title: If validation fails
fields.description: Controls the effect of a failed validation.

choices.value: Fail node (no data scan if structure differs)
choices.label: Fail node (no data scan if structure differs)

choices.value: Deactivate first output port (always scans data)
choices.label: Deactivate first output port (always scans data)

fields.default: Fail node (no data scan if structure differs)
